_about: Memory hooks for words learned by sound (kanji above N3, or kana only). Sino-Japanese words reuse the kanji deck's sound cast (ケツ Ketchup bottle + コン Conductor); native words use an English sound-alike; words built from N5 parts show how. ~sound~ marks the sound hook, {meaning} the meaning. Merged into vocab.json as 'mn' by tools/add_word_hooks.py.
